    Subobjects of interval representations #

    Equation (5.1) and Lemma 5.3 of the manuscript.

    • The nonzero subobjects of M_{a,d} are the suffixes M_{ℓ,d}, a ≤ ℓ ≤ d, embedded by intervalIncl (suffix); every subobject is ⊥ or a suffix (eq_bot_or_eq_suffix), and suffixes are totally ordered.
    • Lemma 5.3: if an interval is a quotient of a direct sum Y₁ ⊞ Y₂, it is a quotient of Y₁ or of Y₂ (epi_or_epi_of_epi_biprod_desc), and dually for subobjects (mono_or_mono_of_mono_biprod_lift).

    The key input is that there is no monomorphism M_{c,d} ⊞ M_{c',d} ⟶ M_{a,d}: a nonzero vector in the kernel is exhibited at the vertex d.

          theorem PretorsionImageClosed.LinearQuiver.eq_bot_or_eq_suffix {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ} {a d : Fin n} (K : CategoryTheory.Subobject (interval k a d)) :
          K = ⊥ ∨ ∃ (ℓ : Fin n) (hal : a ≤ ℓ), ℓ ≤ d ∧ K = suffix a d ℓ hal
